title: Northloop Payments Payout Plan Schedule: Payout Days, Cutoff and Bank Arrival
content:
Every Northloop Payments payout plan fixes when scheduled payouts are initiated, which business-day calendar governs its business-day counts, the Eastern-time cutoff for funds released on a payout day, and how many business days a scheduled payout takes to reach the seller's bank.

## Schedule by plan

| Payout plan | Payments Starter | Payments Biweekly | Payments Weekly | Payments Daily | Payments Daily Plus | Payments Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Scheduled payouts initiated | every Wednesday | every other Wednesday, counted from the plan start | every Wednesday | every business day | every business day | every business day |
| Business-day calendar | Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays | Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays | Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays | Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays | Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays | Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays |
| Payout cutoff (Eastern time) | 17:00 | 17:00 | 17:00 | 17:00 | 17:00 | 17:00 |
| Bank arrival after initiation | 3 business days | 3 business days | 3 business days | 2 business days | 1 business day | 1 business day |

## Terms used in the schedule

- **Scheduled payout days.** The schedule rule states when scheduled payouts are initiated on the plan.
- **Business-day calendar.** The calendar applies to every business-day count of Northloop Payments: Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays, on all six plans.
- **Payout cutoff.** The Eastern-time cutoff (HH:MM) on a payout day for funds released that day to be included; it is 17:00 on all six plans.
- **Bank arrival.** The number of business days for a scheduled payout to reach the bank after initiation.

## Reading the schedule

- On Payments Biweekly the payout Wednesdays alternate, counted from the date the plan started on the account; Payments Starter and Payments Weekly pay every Wednesday.
- Payments Daily, Payments Daily Plus and Payments Enterprise initiate a scheduled payout on every business day of the calendar above.
- Bank arrival is 3 business days on Payments Starter, Payments Biweekly and Payments Weekly, 2 business days on Payments Daily, and 1 business day on Payments Daily Plus and Payments Enterprise, each counted on the calendar above.
